scope: P3 development seed0 full train/validation; no final test selection
budget_policy: one cumulative 72-hour aggregate training/profile budget; no reset
cache_scope: training gradient-enabled prior replay only; inference and measured replay retain uncached raw-history processing; estimated retained plan byte cap, not an exact RSS cap

rationale.core: Preserve synthetic128 optimizer update coverage. Email8 and MOOC128 have finite actual gradient probes. Synthetic V4 at the larger512 batch passed as a memory upper-batch check, not as measured128 throughput. V0/V1 full optimizer convergence remains to be observed.
rationale.strong_baselines: Use exact finite-gradient measured batches DGCRN synthetic128/email4/MOOC128 and official SeqSNN synthetic256/email2/MOOC128. Email SeqSNN8 OOM is preserved and excluded on resource evidence, without reducing dimensions or using an ANN substitute.
rationale.email_episode: Prospective inherited memory bound from main email: same history, features and head with893 versus986 nodes. The episode uses its own training statistics and weights. Its selected batches have not been independently throughput-probed; all actual training timings will be logged.
rationale.training_fairness: Methods share complete epochs, optimizer family, stopping cap and evaluation protocol. Different batch sizes imply different optimizer update counts; report those configurations rather than claim identical update budgets.
rationale.runtime: CUDA selected from actual finite-gradient probes; resource timings under shared load are development diagnostics and do not establish scientific speed or energy claims. Formal CPU/CUDA B1 profiling remains required.

root_acceptance: Resource choice only. P3 and P3A scientific gates remain pending; no hypothesis is accepted by this contract.
